items.label: Answers the prompt
items.student_facing_text: My thesis answers the question the prompt actually asked.
items.check_description: The response engages the prompt's subject rather than a nearby one.

items.label: Arguable position
items.student_facing_text: Someone could disagree with my thesis.
items.check_description: Takes a side. Fails when the thesis restates the prompt or states a fact nobody would contest.

items.label: Specific
items.student_facing_text: My thesis names something specific, not just 'things' or 'society'.
items.check_description: Carries concrete content words rather than leaning on vague nouns.

items.label: Thesis stands on its own
items.student_facing_text: My thesis is one sentence, and my argument comes after it.
items.check_description: The response has more than one sentence and the opening sentence is not carrying the argument inside it. Distinct from tier 1's one_sentence, which measures the whole response.

items.label: Argument stated
items.student_facing_text: I said why I think my thesis is true.
items.check_description: A reason follows the thesis rather than a restatement of it.

items.label: Argument matches thesis
items.student_facing_text: My argument is about the same thing as my thesis.
items.check_description: The argument shares the thesis's subject rather than drifting to a new one.

items.label: Evidence present
items.student_facing_text: I used a quote from the passage.
items.check_description: Text matching the assigned passage appears in the response.

items.label: Evidence relevant
items.student_facing_text: My quote is about the thing my thesis is about.
items.check_description: The quoted words share the thesis's subject.

items.label: Evidence integrated
items.student_facing_text: I led into my quote instead of dropping it in by itself.
items.check_description: A signal phrase introduces the quotation rather than the quotation standing as its own sentence.
